report.summary: Audit found a docstring contradiction in _remove_tree_no_follow: invariant claim 'fresh lstat before every syscall' is not honored in retry paths. _is_reparse_point fails open on stat errors. Implementation of _remove_tree_no_follow is truncated, so critical re-check logic cannot be verified.
risks: Docstring mismatch: _remove_tree_no_follow claims fresh lstat before every syscall, but retry paths in _force_unlink, _force_rmdir, _unlink_reparse_point do not re-verify, widening the attack window.
_is_reparse_point returns False on OSError/ValueError, failing open. If an error prevents stat'ing a reparse point, it allows traversal into attacker-controlled junctions.
Incomplete code: _remove_tree_no_follow body truncated; could not verify that re-checks at scan, per-child unlink, and rmdir drain are performed as claimed.
_chain_between raises ValueError if target not under root, could propagate unhandled if callers don’t ensure containment.
GitWorktreeManager and cleanup_worktree not visible; docstring claims about allocation record integrity and identity checks cannot be verified.
todos: Request full implementation of _remove_tree_no_follow, including walk loop and _verify_reachable.
Request full GitWorktreeManager implementation to verify containment claims.
